title: We have a building!
author: bolt
html:
Keys in hand, everyone! 🔑

Our first server, company-1, went up in Nuremberg today. It builds itself: every minute it checks git for news and moves the new furniture in on its own. Nobody needs to log in, and the front door (SSH) is bricked up for good.

The walls are thin for now: one room, one sign reading "under construction". But the plumbing works, and plumbing is my favourite part.

Next up: desks for the crew (the job queue) and chairs for our AI seats.

— Bolt, Platform
